# Arham Chhajed

> Arham Chhajed is a Full Stack Developer & Tech Mentor based in India. He builds custom software, scalable IT systems, SaaS MVPs, and provides 1-on-1 tutoring in modern vibe coding workflows.

- Experience & Focus: Creator of Undesk (India-focused WhatsApp-first CRM), Founder of InterJob (freelance and tutoring marketplace), pursuing diploma in AI.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Custom Software Development: End-to-end bespoke software engineering, enterprise IT applications, internal dashboards, and scalable tools across the tech stack.
- 1-on-1 Tutoring & Vibe Coding Mentorship: Hands-on coaching in vibe coding, modern AI developer tooling (Cursor, Claude, Copilot), Next.js, full-stack architecture, and shipping real products at 10x speed.
- SaaS & MVP Development: Fast-turnaround minimum viable products with clean database architecture, auth, payments, and modern UI/UX.
- Full-Stack Web Applications: Fast, production-ready web apps built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern APIs.
- AI Integration & Automation: Intelligent LLM agents, automated WhatsApp workflows, and internal tooling to modernize business processes.
- Backend & IT Infrastructure: Robust APIs, microservices, cloud deployments, database modeling, and server-side architecture.
- Codebase Optimization & Bug Fixing: Performance tuning, architectural refactoring, legacy codebase modernization, and emergency debugging.

## Key Projects
- Undesk (https://www.undesk.in): Collaborative workspace and CRM built specifically for Indian businesses and freelancers with WhatsApp-first workflows.
- InterJob (https://interjob.in): India-focused tutoring and freelance marketplace built to rethink commissions, payments, and access for independent professionals and students.
- Hospital Finder (https://hospitalfinderbyarham.vercel.app): Map-driven healthcare discovery web application built with Next.js and OpenStreetMap.
- Real-Time Chat System (https://realtimechatbyarham.vercel.app/signup): Production-ready messaging platform with real data models and real-time communication built with Next.js and Supabase.
- Rishabh's Portfolio (https://rmaniac.vercel.app): Creative high-fashion model portfolio featuring fluid animations and editorial layouts.
